objective: A signed-in member can review their own activity on a History page with four tabs: posts, replies, likes and reposts.
acceptance_criteria: Test-first: commit the failing tests alone before the implementation; the implementation commit edits no test.

GET /feed/history?tab=posts|replies|likes|reposts&cursor=&limit= is on the active-account path: 401 with no token, 403 account_deactivated when deactivated, and an unknown tab or bad cursor is a 422. limit is 1 to 50, default 20. It reads no user id from the request, so a caller can only ever see their own history.

posts is the caller's top-level originals: no reply, no repost. replies is their replies. reposts is their plain and quote reposts. likes is the posts they liked. Each is newest first: by post id, and by when they liked it for likes.

A post the caller deleted, or a liked post deleted by its author or by a deactivated author, never appears. A plain repost whose original is gone still appears with the existing Post deleted treatment. Each item is the same PostView the feed returns, including liked and reposted flags, through assemble_post_views.
The cursor is opaque. Pages neither repeat nor skip an item when a new item arrives between them, including two likes with the same timestamp, and the last page has a null next cursor.
The query count for a page does not grow with its size, pinned by a test. A new index on post_likes(user_id, created_at DESC, post_id DESC) serves likes; each of the others states the index it reads.
feed/ reads through a public function in app.posts.service, not posts' tables, per the Connection rule.

/history is behind RequireAuth, with a heading History, and Tabs named Posts, Replies, Likes and Reposts. The tab is the URL (?tab=), defaulting to Posts, and an unknown value shows Posts. Each tab uses the feed's post cards, a Load more button, and its own empty state in plain words.
Switching tabs and returning does not refetch within staleTime. Unliking a post or undoing a repost in the page behaves as it does in the feed. A failed read shows the shared alert with Retry.
No link in the shell reaches the page in this unit; USERS-006 adds the menu.

Browser rows at 360 and 1280, light and dark, on localhost test accounts, reported with measurements or NOT DONE: each tab with data; each empty; Load more; keyboard across tabs; 200% text size; no horizontal overflow.
frontend/src/test/bundle-budgets/POSTS-008.ts declares, in the test commit, every output the unit changes. Entry growth is at most 2 KiB raw and 1 KiB gzip, and no output reaches 500,000 raw bytes.
wiki/CodeContext/Modules/0x03-posts.md, 0x06-feed.md and 0x08-frontend.md record the route and page.
